messages:
Emma: Vendor emailed: proposing split delivery for EMEA H100 replacements — 10 units via air (express), rest by sea. Need decision today about AWB consolidation and customs paperwork.

Luca: Vendor timeline: air ETA ~4 days, sea ETA ~30 days. Can supply 10 loaners for RMA at 12% premium plus brokerage. They request serials CSV for partial manifest.

Raj: How many prod hosts down? outage windows?

Sophie: 15 hosts impacted across eu-west-1a/1c. Some pools at ~70% of target N, auto-failover tripping more frequently.

Emma: If air covers the most critical racks in AMS that should keep customer-facing latency stable. Can loaners + cross-region borrowing hold us until sea replacements arrive?

Luca: Loaners cover immediate compute but we'll need KV cache warm-up and rebalancing. Consolidated AWB can speed customs but increases risk of end-use checks — vendor warns possible +5–9 day hold in certain EU hubs.

Sophie: My recommendation: do NOT consolidate the air AWB. Split the shipments: air loaners as separate AWBs with local brokerage instructions, sea as consolidated manifest for efficiency.

Emma: @Luca can you confirm serial upload and who absorbs brokerage? Finance needs delta for PO.

Luca: Uploading serials to vendor portal now. Vendor will absorb 40% of brokerage if we accept sea timing. Loaner surcharge likely on us; I'm pushing to reduce from 12% but expect we cover most.

ops-bot: Created ticket PROV-4620 for RMA coordination, loaner acceptance, and manifest notes — https://redwood.infra/tickets/PROV-4620

Raj: Short-term infra plan: accept 10 air loaners. I'll repurpose 12 non-prod GPUs from us-west for low-priority batch work to free up capacity in eu-west. Cross-region egress + instance prep ~36–60h, expect batch latency spikes while warmup runs.

Emma: Call out cost tradeoffs: cross-region egress estimate and the loaner surcharge ballpark. We need to surface this to finance.

Nina: Looping in finance — please provide PO delta and cost center. Anything > $30k requires director signoff per policy.

Luca: Preliminary PO delta (loaners + brokerage) ~= $38,200. I'll post final numbers in PROV-4620 within a couple hours.

Sophie: Orchestration/warmup notes after loaners arrive:

```
./scripts/kv_warmup --region eu-west-1 --hosts 10 --profile prod
kubectl -n eu-prod rollout restart deployment/llm-serving
```

Emma: Monitoring: set canary tail-latency threshold to 450ms and alert if tail > 450ms or error rate >3%. If customs holds sea beyond 12 days fallback is to burst critical routes to us-east Dedicated for short windows.

ops-bot: PROV-4620 status -> waiting on vendor AWB confirmation and final PO details.

Emma: I'll draft a 1-paragraph exec summary with impact bullets and cost delta. Please drop any PO numbers, vendor confirmations, or customs notes into PROV-4620. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
